questions.question: What is My Dubai Broker?
questions.answer: My Dubai Broker is a premium marketplace for high-end assets including real estate, cars, yachts, and jets in Dubai.

questions.question: How does My Dubai Broker work?
questions.answer: We provide a verified platform connecting serious buyers with professional sellers for exclusive luxury assets.

questions.question: How are assets verified?
questions.answer: Every asset listed is checked for authenticity and ownership documentation by our curation team.

questions.question: How do I register as a seller or business?
questions.answer: You can register through our business portal by providing necessary commercial license and documentation.

questions.question: What are the photo requirements?
questions.answer: We require high-resolution (HD) photos that meet our luxury aesthetic standards.

questions.question: How can I edit my listings?
questions.answer: You can manage and edit your listings through your dedicated business dashboard.

questions.question: Can I feature my brand logo?
questions.answer: Yes, verified businesses can display their logo on their profile and listing pages.

questions.question: How do I receive inquiries?
questions.answer: Inquiries are sent directly to your dashboard and registered email address.

questions.question: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.answer: We accept major credit cards, bank transfers, and local payment methods in Dubai.

questions.question: What data can I see about my listings?
questions.answer: You can track views, clicks, and lead performance for each of your listed assets.

questions.question: How is my account secured?
questions.answer: We use 256-bit encryption and multi-factor authentication for all business accounts.

questions.question: How do I register as a buyer?
questions.answer: Registration is free and allows you to save favorites and receive notifications for matching assets.

questions.question: How do I save a search?
questions.answer: Click the heart icon on any search results page to save the criteria for later.

questions.question: What is the best way to contact a seller?
questions.answer: Use the secure inquiry form on the listing page to connect with the verified seller or broker.

questions.question: How can I manage my alerts?
questions.answer: You can toggle notification preferences within your account settings.

questions.question: What does 'Verified' mean?
questions.answer: 'Verified' means we have confirmed the identity of the seller and the basic legitimacy of the asset.
